description: A listing draft — title, subtitle, promotional text and description — built from the keywords measured for this app in one storefront, ordered by demand. Every field comes with its character count against the store limit, plus two review checks: an Apple product name in the title or subtitle (App Store only) and pricing language. `termsUsed` lists the measured terms behind it; `excluded` the tracked terms still to be measured. Nothing is written to the store — update_listing does that. Uses one AI writing credit (Pro and above).

cc.description: storefront code, e.g. tr, us (defaults to the app's first country)

name: draft_listing
